claimSegments: A stable key helps React match an item to its previous instance within a list of siblings. Reordering should not make one item inherit the local state of another.
An array index can be a poor key when items move, are inserted or removed. A freshly generated random key also destroys continuity between renders.
Practice: explain why editing a row can reveal a bad key choice.
packet.sourceText:
SHELF SAMPLES / 03
Keys describe identity
A stable key helps React match an item to its previous
instance within a list of siblings. Reordering should
not make one item inherit the local state of another.
items.map(item => (
<Row key={item.id} item={item} />
));
An array index can be a poor key when items move,
are inserted or removed. A freshly generated random
key also destroys continuity between renders.
Practice: explain why editing a row can reveal a bad key
choice.
